fact: Sierra Leone's National Public Procurement Authority chief executive Fodie Konneh said it is continuing to develop its own e-procurement system and sent a delegation to Liberia to learn from Liberia's deployed e-GP system.

Sierraloaded reports the National Public Procurement Authority launched the Procurement Requisition and Bid Publication modules of the Salone e-GP System on 7 July 2026, enabling online publication of procurement opportunities.

Sierraloaded reports the National Public Procurement Authority began training pilot ministries and agencies on 22-25 June 2026 on electronic bid submission in the Salone e-GP system, as part of its phased implementation.
Sierraloaded reports the National Public Procurement Authority launched an online e-GP Portal for supplier registration and access to tender notices, announced in Public Notice Circular 02-2025.

NPPA chief executive Fodie Konneh said the Salone e-GP System has had its Procurement Requisition and Bid Publication modules soft-launched, after the User Management, Supplier Registration, Price Norm and Annual Procurement Planning modules were deployed.
